popCulture.title: Alcmaeon in Psophis
popCulture.creator: Euripides
popCulture.description: Euripides' lost tragedy stages Alcmaeon's purification at Phegeus' court — the Arcadian king who shelters the matricide and gives him a daughter, then orders the ambush when the necklace is stolen back.

popCulture.title: Phegeus of Psophis
popCulture.description: King of Psophis, son of Alpheus — purifier of Alcmaeon, father of Arsinoe/Alphesiboea, keeper and then avenger of Harmonia's necklace.

popCulture.title: Alcmaeon
popCulture.description: Phegeus' guest and son-in-law — the Epigoni leader whose second marriage for Callirrhoe costs him his life at Psophis.

popCulture.title: Necklace of Harmonia
popCulture.description: The bridal gift Alcmaeon leaves with Phegeus' daughter — the jewel that sterilizes Psophis and triggers the king's murderous revenge.
